data.name: Fatmah
data.gender_notes: Fatmah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fatmah is the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the half-sister of the Prophet's daughter, Umm Kulthum. The name Fatmah carries the meaning “Daughter of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatmah usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fatmah is often referred to as the 'Sayyida' (Lady) of all women in Islamic tradition, due to her noble lineage and piety.
data.etymology: Fatmah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Daughter of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatmah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: فاطمة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الفتك والانقطاع من الشيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاطمة اسم مشتق من الفطام، وهو الانقطاع والفتك. ورد اسم فاطمة في القرآن الكريم، وهي بنت النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، واسمها يدل على قوة الشخصية والانتماء إلى الله

in_urdu.name: فاطمہ
in_urdu.meaning: وہ جو ہر چیز سے الگ ہو، قطع تعلق
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاطمہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'فطم' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں 'الگ کرنا' یا 'قطع تعلق'۔ یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں بہت اہم ہے کیونکہ یہ رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی بیٹی فاطمہ زہرا کا نام ہے۔ اس نام کا روحانی مطلب ہے کسی بھی چیز سے الگ ہونا اور صرف اللہ سے منسلک ہونا

in_hindi.name: फातिमा
in_hindi.meaning: जो हर चीज़ से अलग हो, संबंध विच्छेद
in_hindi.long_meaning: फातिमा एक ऐसा नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के शब्दों से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'अलग करना' या 'संबंध विच्छेद'। इस नाम का इस्लामी इतिहास में बहुत महत्व है क्योंकि यह पैगंबर मुहम्मद की बेटी फातिमा का नाम है। इस नाम का आध्यात्मिक अर्थ है किसी भी चीज़ से अलग होना और केवल अल्लाह से जुड़ना

in_pashto.name: فاطمه
in_pashto.meaning: هغه څوک چې له هر څه جلا وي، قطع رابطه
in_pashto.long_meaning: فاطمه داسې نوم دی چې د عربي کلمو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې دي 'جلا کول' یا 'قطع رابطه'۔ دا نوم په اسلامي تاريخ کې ډېر مهم دی ځکه چې دا د رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم د لور فاطمې نوم دی. ددې نوم روحاني مطلب دی له هر څه څخه جلا او يوازې د الله سره نښلول

in_english.name: Fatmah
in_english.meaning: one who detaches from worldly things
in_english.long_meaning: Fatmah is a name derived from the Arabic root 'f-t-m', meaning 'to detach' or 'to wean'. In Islamic tradition, Fatimah was the name of the Prophet Muhammad's daughter, symbolizing strength and devotion to God. The name implies spiritual detachment from worldly affairs and a strong connection to Allah

data.cultural_impact: Fatima/Fatmah is one of the most revered names in the Islamic world. She is a symbol of strong faith, courage, and determination. The name Fatima/Fatmah is mentioned in numerous traditions and hadiths of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It is believed that by naming a child Fatima/Fatmah, her parents bestow upon her the qualities of obedience, piety, and devotion to Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: Fatima/Fatmah is considered a role model for Muslim women. Her life is a testimony to her unwavering dedication to her faith and her love for the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). She is also known to have had a deep spiritual connection with Allah. In Islamic tradition, she is regarded as the Mother of Martyrs because her husband and two of her sons were martyred. Her name is a reminder of the spiritual power and strength that resides within every Muslim, especially women, and the importance of maintaining a strong connection with Allah throughout one's life.
